display.description:
Records still pending or being processed. Compare the current stage and time since the last update; a long transfer can be legitimate.

Measurement details:
Count of retained import objects in the selected scope. Unknown/new phases are not silently classified as succeeded. A zero is produced only while inventory collection is healthy.
display.name: Imports still in progress

spec.query: count(max by (cluster_name,namespace,import_name,target_vm,source_kind,phase,outcome) (harvester_import_info{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}",namespace=~"${import_namespace}",import_name=~"${import_name}",outcome="active"}) and on (cluster_name) (max by (cluster_name) (harvester_import_inventory_up{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}"}) == 1)) or (0 * sum(max by (cluster_name) (harvester_import_inventory_up{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}"}) == 1))

display.description:
Elapsed time including queueing and all processing stages. This does not predict when the import will finish.

Measurement details:
Elapsed time from object creation for active imports only. Includes queueing and all stages; no promised completion time is inferred.
display.name: Time since an active import was created (seconds)

display.description:
1 means recent API reads succeeded; 0 means they failed or became stale. This must work before a zero import count can be trusted.

Measurement details:
API read success and exporter freshness. HTTP scrape success alone is insufficient: this signal becomes 0 on API errors or stale polling.
display.name: Can we read the import inventory?

display.description:
CPU used by each controller container over five minutes. 1000 mCPU equals one CPU core. Compare a slowdown with CPU, memory and network together.

Measurement details:
Direct TLS-verified kubelet /metrics/cadvisor collection. Cluster scope; import and namespace filters do not apply. CPU is mCPU (1000 = one core), memory is working-set bytes. Empty is missing telemetry, not zero. Collection can be disabled with imports.performance.enabled: false.
display.name: Import controller: CPU used (mCPU)

display.description:
Working-set memory per controller container. Compare the trend with its configured limit and logs.

Measurement details:
Direct TLS-verified kubelet /metrics/cadvisor collection. Cluster scope; import and namespace filters do not apply. CPU is mCPU (1000 = one core), memory is working-set bytes. Empty is missing telemetry, not zero. Collection can be disabled with imports.performance.enabled: false.
display.name: Import controller: memory used

display.description:
Receive bytes per second per Pod interface, averaged over five minutes. Includes all imports and control traffic; not transfer speed for one VM.

Measurement details:
cAdvisor per-Pod interface counter. rate() is applied before deduplication by cluster, namespace, pod and interface. Loopback excluded. Cluster scope: import and namespace filters do not narrow shared infrastructure. No bandwidth percentage without an independently known link capacity. No active-transfer validation in this lab; retained imports are completed.
display.name: Import controller: incoming network traffic (bytes/s)

display.description:
Transmit bytes per second per Pod interface, averaged over five minutes. Disk export and image serving are separate stages; do not add receive and transmit as unique migrated bytes.

Measurement details:
cAdvisor per-Pod interface counter. rate() is applied before deduplication by cluster, namespace, pod and interface. Loopback excluded. Cluster scope: import and namespace filters do not narrow shared infrastructure. No bandwidth percentage without an independently known link capacity. No active-transfer validation in this lab; retained imports are completed.
display.name: Import controller: outgoing network traffic (bytes/s)

display.description:
Percentage of recorded disks marked ready. Even at 100%, VM creation and boot may still be pending; this is not transfer progress.

Measurement details:
Number of disk records with VirtualMachineImageReady=True divided by recorded disks. A 100% value covers the disk-image stage only; VM creation and boot can still be pending. No disks means undefined, not 100%.
display.name: Disk images ready for the VM

spec.query: 100 * (max by (cluster_name,namespace,import_name,target_vm,source_kind) (harvester_import_disks{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}",namespace=~"${import_namespace}",import_name=~"${import_name}",state="ready"}) and on (cluster_name) (max by (cluster_name) (harvester_import_inventory_up{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}"}) == 1)) / ((max by (cluster_name,namespace,import_name,target_vm,source_kind) (harvester_import_disks{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}",namespace=~"${import_namespace}",import_name=~"${import_name}",state="total"}) and on (cluster_name) (max by (cluster_name) (harvester_import_inventory_up{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}"}) == 1)) > 0)

display.description:
Counts of disk objects recorded for each import. Compare ready with total; a failed disk requires checking controller events.

Measurement details:
Counts recorded total, ready and failed disks. Ready takes precedence over an old failed condition after recovery. These are disk objects, not bytes transferred.
display.name: Total, ready and failed disks per import

display.description:
Import records classified as failed or invalid. Inspect the controller resource and events for the cause before retrying.

Measurement details:
Count of retained import objects in the selected scope. Unknown/new phases are not silently classified as succeeded. A zero is produced only while inventory collection is healthy.
display.name: Failed or invalid imports

spec.query: count(max by (cluster_name,namespace,import_name,target_vm,source_kind,phase,outcome) (harvester_import_info{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}",namespace=~"${import_namespace}",import_name=~"${import_name}",outcome="failed"}) and on (cluster_name) (max by (cluster_name) (harvester_import_inventory_up{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}"}) == 1)) or (0 * sum(max by (cluster_name) (harvester_import_inventory_up{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}"}) == 1))

display.description: Which VMware imports have finished, failed or are still being processed by VM Import Controller?
display.name: What this dashboard tells you

spec.text: **Which VMware imports have finished, failed or are still being processed by VM Import Controller?** Select an import to see its current stage and disk preparation. Completed means the controller recorded the VM starting; check the application separately. Disk readiness is not the percentage of data transferred. This dashboard does not cover Coriolis. **No data is not the same as zero.** Select a cluster before narrowing the next filters. **None** selects nothing; **Everything** selects all available values. After changing a cluster, reset the following filters to Everything. Full names and values opens the complete resource list.

display.description:
Network receive rate for Longhorn backing-image managers and data sources. These services also handle non-import images; this is shared infrastructure traffic.

Measurement details:
cAdvisor per-Pod interface counter. rate() is applied before deduplication by cluster, namespace, pod and interface. Loopback excluded. Cluster scope: import and namespace filters do not narrow shared infrastructure. No bandwidth percentage without an independently known link capacity. No active-transfer validation in this lab; retained imports are completed.
display.name: Shared image services: incoming network traffic (bytes/s)

display.description:
Network transmit rate for shared image services. Interface labels keep management and storage networks separate. This is not attributed to the selected import.

Measurement details:
cAdvisor per-Pod interface counter. rate() is applied before deduplication by cluster, namespace, pod and interface. Loopback excluded. Cluster scope: import and namespace filters do not narrow shared infrastructure. No bandwidth percentage without an independently known link capacity. No active-transfer validation in this lab; retained imports are completed.
display.name: Shared image services: outgoing network traffic (bytes/s)

display.description:
Age of the latest recorded condition. Long copy stages may have no updates, so an old condition alone does not prove a stalled transfer.

Measurement details:
Age of the newest condition timestamp for active imports. Long copy operations may legitimately have no condition updates; this is an investigation signal, not proof that transfer stalled.
display.name: Time since an active import last changed status (seconds)

spec.query: (time() - (max by (cluster_name,namespace,import_name,target_vm,source_kind) (harvester_import_last_condition_timestamp_seconds{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}",namespace=~"${import_namespace}",import_name=~"${import_name}"}) and on (cluster_name) (max by (cluster_name) (harvester_import_inventory_up{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}"}) == 1))) and on (cluster_name,namespace,import_name) (harvester_import_info{cluster_name=~"${import_cluster}",namespace=~"${import_namespace}",import_name=~"${import_name}",outcome="active"})

display.description:
Logical disk sizes read from the controller. These are not bytes already transferred or measured storage usage.

Measurement details:
Sum diskSize from the controller API. Logical source disk capacity, not bytes copied, allocated storage or measured throughput. Missing sizes remain absent.
display.name: Source disk capacity recorded by the import

display.description:
1 means the kubelet metrics endpoint answered; 0 means failure. This does not prove matching importer Pods exist. Check TLS, TCP/10250 and nodes/metrics access if collection fails.

Measurement details:
Direct TLS-verified kubelet /metrics/cadvisor collection. Cluster scope; import and namespace filters do not apply. CPU is mCPU (1000 = one core), memory is working-set bytes. Empty is missing telemetry, not zero. Collection can be disabled with imports.performance.enabled: false.
display.name: Can we collect import performance metrics?

display.description:
The legend identifies each import and the stage recorded by the controller. A line at 1 marks the recorded stage; it is not a completion percentage.

Measurement details:
Each visible series has value 1 and names the controller phase. virtualMachineRunning is the terminal controller status; it is not a current guest-health check.
display.name: Current stage of each import

display.description:
Duration of stages with explicit start and end timestamps. These intervals do not measure the entire migration or application acceptance.

Measurement details:
poweroff_to_export: VMPoweredOff → VMExported. images_submitted_to_ready: earliest submitted → latest ready across all disks, only when every disk has timestamps. These intervals do not include full boot/application acceptance and are not end-to-end migration duration.
